title: PHYSICAL RETENTION CANDIDATE CAPABILITY AUDIT

critical_noncollapse.capability_in_principle: A representation is information-theoretically able to preserve/reconstruct a dimension if the stated fields and exact identity semantics are retained.
critical_noncollapse.populated_equivalence: Whether the current populated instance actually retains those fields, multiplicities, overlaps, weights, routing states and source equivalence. Unknown for DB-backed candidates under D05.
critical_noncollapse.static_equivalence: Whether an external/raw or hybrid snapshot is exactly the intended source artifact with complete provenance. Unknown unless separately hash/provenance proven.

binding_holdings: D07: future-authorized empirical queryability/reconstructibility is governing; blanket materialize-all is not.
D08: E1 conditional facts, E2 multivariate joint incidence and exact E0B branch/cohort incidence share a typed deep respondent-bound algebra; E3/E4 are derived lanes.
D08: arbitrary new reconditioning requires respondent membership/incidence or an exact information-equivalent contingency containing every requested dimension.
D10: empirical coordinate identity must not be collapsed into nine-stratum generated-position ontology.
D11: current canonical downstream consumption is narrow; V550J aggregate joint semantics can survive after exact respondent membership stops at V550J.
D05: current populated completeness, source equivalence, overlap and ingestion-loss facts remain unknown.

proofs.holding: Selective aggregate marginals/conditionals and scalar association summaries cannot reconstruct arbitrary unseen joint incidence.

An exact E2 contingency is sufficient for queries over its retained dimensions/risk-set semantics, but cannot be reconditioned on a new coordinate absent from that contingency unless respondent membership/deeper incidence survives.
Scalar respondent/question rows without explicit event/set/order semantics are not a generic lossless carrier for multiselect, repeated-event or ranked topology.
A branch label/tree summary is not branch membership. Exact branch-conditioned replay requires a deterministic branch predicate or member set plus branch-law provenance.
A hybrid can union information retained by its components only through exact identity/provenance joins; it cannot reconstruct a dimension lost by every surviving component.
hostile_witnesses: future coordinate absent from all components

proofs.holding: Static schema/format capability does not prove that the present populated DB/cache is source-equivalent.

C10.name: Hybrids of source + cache + materialized facts

selection_prohibitions: No candidate is selected as final retention substrate.
No candidate is recommended for implementation.
No D12 terminal-necessity classification is pre-empted.
